## 🚀 About Me

I'm a **Senior Software Engineer** and **Applied AI Engineer** passionate about building solutions at the intersection of software engineering and artificial intelligence.

With deep full-stack development experience and a track record of delivering AI-powered features and agentic systems, I focus on turning emerging AI capabilities into production-ready tools that solve real problems. I combine hands-on technical expertise with strong architectural thinking, whether it's building RAG systems, designing scalable infrastructure, or implementing comprehensive monitoring and observability.

I thrive on bridging technical excellence with practical impact, creating dependable systems that help developers and teams work faster and smarter.
